__: The version of each PRODUCT in this repository, and the only place it is decided. Every other spelling -- config.h, module.json, the Info.plists and each engine's crates -- is DERIVED from this and checked by `ctest -R versions`. The scheme is v<YYYY.MM.DD>.<subversion>; three of those consumers cannot hold that string literally, so the derivations are spelled out in tests/versions.test.mjs and asserted rather than left to a human. See tests/versions.test.mjs for what is checked and what is deliberately not.
